byte_rules: UTF-8, no BOM/newline; ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False; arrays preserve order
checkpoint_blob_publication: write immutable blobs atomically before checkpoint references
effective_state_digest: H(canonical native effective field projection including saved ledger and counters, excluding backend/job/profile)
fairness: same native snapshot/profile/input gate/F0/original physics; E2 float internals differ from exact new core; compare complete backend, not pure EMS mechanism
geometry_scalar_encoding: continuous values are canonical finite decimal strings; bool/ID/enum/index retain explicit kinds
geometry_values_digest: H(canonical geometry payload); profile is separately mandatory even if values equal

interfaces.name: generate_runtime_snapshot_v1
interfaces.reuse: single parsed-input generation/reduction core after separately authorized refactor

legacy_entrypoint: generate(raw) source-lexeme contract and old adapt remain unchanged; no relabeling runtime bytes as geometry_physical_input_v1

resume_rules.COMMITTED: snapshot matches pending.before; cp.state matches pending.after; no duplicate place
resume_rules.MONITORED: reuse saved monitor, do not reassess; match before
resume_rules.SELECTED: reuse original bytes/pool/context/selection; match before and cp.state
